decisions.reason: A very obscure line (m1); Literal follows the reading the English takes.

source.text: רָא֤וּךָ יָחִ֨ילוּ֙ הָרִ֔ים זֶ֥רֶם מַ֖יִם עָבָ֑ר נָתַ֤ן תְּהוֹם֙ קוֹל֔וֹ ר֖וֹם יָדֵ֥יהוּ נָשָֽׂא׃

records.literal_gloss: They saw you; they writhe, mountains; a downpour of water passed over; gave the deep its voice; [on] high its hands it lifted.

en.L: [The] mountains saw {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; they writhed; \q a downpour of water passed by; \q the deep gave its voice; \q it lifted its hands on high.
en.B: The mountains saw {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} and writhed; \q a torrent of water swept past; \q the deep roared aloud \q and lifted its hands high.
en.R: When the mountains saw {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, they shook. \q Floods of water rushed by. \q The deep ocean roared \q and raised its waves high.

es.L: [Los] montes {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} vieron; se retorcieron; \q un aguacero de aguas pasó; \q el abismo dio su voz; \q en alto alzó sus manos.
es.B: Los montes {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} vieron y se retorcieron; \q un torrente de agua pasó con fuerza; \q el abismo rugió \q y alzó en alto sus manos.
es.R: Cuando los montes {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} vieron, temblaron. \q Pasaron inundaciones de agua. \q El océano profundo rugió \q y levantó muy alto sus olas.

fr.L: [Les] montagnes {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}ont vu ; elles se sont tordues ; \q une averse d’eaux est passée ; \q l’abîme a fait entendre sa voix ; \q il a levé ses mains en haut.
fr.B: Les montagnes {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}ont vu et se sont tordues ; \q un torrent d’eaux a déferlé ; \q l’abîme a grondé \q et levé ses mains bien haut.
fr.R: Quand les montagnes {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}ont vu, elles ont tremblé. \q Des flots d’eau ont déferlé. \q L’océan profond a grondé \q et soulevé très haut ses vagues.

sw.L: Milima ilikuona; ilitetemeka kwa uchungu; \q mvua kubwa ya maji ilipita; \q kilindi kilitoa sauti yake; \q kiliinua mikono yake juu.
sw.B: Milima ilikuona ikagaagaa kwa uchungu; \q mafuriko ya maji yakapita kwa kasi; \q kilindi kikanguruma \q na kuinua mikono yake juu.
sw.R: Milima ilipokuona, ilitetemeka. \q Mafuriko ya maji yalipita kwa kasi. \q Bahari kuu ilinguruma \q na kuyainua mawimbi yake juu.

vi.L: Các núi đã thấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; chúng quằn quại; \q một cơn mưa nước tràn qua; \q vực sâu cất tiếng mình; \q nó giơ tay lên cao.
vi.B: Các núi thấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và quằn quại; \q một dòng nước lũ ào qua; \q vực sâu gầm vang \q và giơ tay lên cao.
vi.R: Khi các núi thấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, chúng rúng động. \q Nước lũ ào ào tràn qua. \q Đại dương sâu thẳm gầm thét \q và dâng sóng lên cao.

ko.L: 산들이 주님을 보고 몸부림쳤습니다. \q 물의 폭우가 지나갔습니다. \q 깊은 바다가 소리를 내고, \q 높이 그 손을 들었습니다.
ko.B: 산들이 주님을 보고 뒤틀렸습니다. \q 거센 물살이 휩쓸고 지나가고, \q 깊은 바다가 크게 울부짖으며 \q 그 손을 높이 들었습니다.
ko.R: 산들이 주님을 보고 떨었습니다. \q 큰물이 쏟아져 지나갔습니다. \q 깊은 바다가 소리치며 \q 파도를 높이 일으켰습니다.

decisions.choice: the mountains saw you and writhed ... the deep gave its voice: Psalm 77:17-19
decisions.reason: Psalm 77:17-19 says: "The waters saw you, God; ... the deeps trembled", with storm and thunder, in a psalm that also recalls the exodus. Habakkuk applies the picture to the mountains and the deep.

decisions.choice: it lifted its hands on high: the deep raised its waves
decisions.reason: The deep is pictured as a living thing that cries out and lifts its hands, perhaps in fear or surrender. The picture is of its waves rising high.

decisions.choice: raised its waves high
decisions.reason: Readable says what the deep's "hands" are (m2).

source.text: שֶׁ֥מֶשׁ יָרֵ֖חַ עָ֣מַד זְבֻ֑לָה לְא֤וֹר חִצֶּ֨יךָ֙ יְהַלֵּ֔כוּ לְנֹ֖גַהּ בְּרַ֥ק חֲנִיתֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Sun, moon stood still [in their] dwelling; at [the] light of your arrows they went, at [the] brightness of [the] lightning of your spear.

en.L: Sun [and] moon stood still in [their] dwelling \q at the light of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} arrows [as] they flew, \q at the gleam of the lightning of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} spear.
en.B: Sun and moon stood still in the heavens \q at the light of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} flying arrows, \q at the flash of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} gleaming spear.
en.R: The sun and moon stopped in the sky \q when they saw {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} arrows flash by \q and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} spear shine like lightning.

es.L: Sol [y] luna se detuvieron en [su] morada \q a la luz de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} flechas [que] volaban, \q al resplandor del relámpago de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} lanza.
es.B: El sol y la luna se detuvieron en el cielo \q ante la luz de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} flechas que volaban, \q ante el destello de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} lanza reluciente.
es.R: El sol y la luna se pararon en el cielo \q cuando vieron pasar volando {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} flechas \q y brillar {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} lanza como un relámpago.

fr.L: Soleil [et] lune se sont arrêtés dans [leur] demeure \q à la lumière de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} flèches [qui] volaient, \q à l’éclat de l’éclair de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} lance.
fr.B: Le soleil et la lune se sont arrêtés dans les cieux \q à la lumière de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} flèches qui volaient, \q à l’éclair de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} lance étincelante.
fr.R: Le soleil et la lune se sont arrêtés dans le ciel \q quand ils ont vu filer {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} flèches \q et briller {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} lance comme l’éclair.

sw.L: Jua [na] mwezi vilisimama katika makao [yao] \q kwa nuru ya mishale {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} [ilipokuwa ikiruka], \q kwa mng'ao wa umeme wa mkuki {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.B: Jua na mwezi vilisimama mbinguni \q kwa nuru ya mishale {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} iliyoruka, \q kwa mwako wa mkuki {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} unaometameta.
sw.R: Jua na mwezi vilisimama angani \q vilipoona mishale {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ikipita kwa kasi \q na mkuki {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} ukiangaza kama umeme.

vi.L: Mặt trời [và] mặt trăng đứng yên trong chỗ ở [của chúng] \q trước ánh sáng của các mũi tên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [khi] chúng bay, \q trước ánh chớp của cây giáo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Mặt trời và mặt trăng đứng yên trên trời \q trước ánh sáng các mũi tên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bay vút, \q trước ánh chớp của cây giáo sáng ngời của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Mặt trời và mặt trăng dừng lại trên bầu trời \q khi thấy các mũi tên của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lóe sáng bay qua \q và cây giáo {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sáng chói như tia chớp.

ko.L: 해[와] 달이 [그들의] 처소에 멈추어 섰습니다. \q 날아가는 주님의 화살들의 빛 때문에, \q 주님의 창의 번쩍이는 번개 때문에 [그리하였습니다].
ko.B: 해와 달이 하늘에 멈추어 섰습니다. \q 날아가는 주님의 화살의 빛과 \q 번쩍이는 주님의 창의 섬광 앞에서였습니다.
ko.R: 해와 달이 하늘에서 멈추어 섰습니다. \q 주님의 화살이 번쩍이며 날아가는 것을 보고, \q 주님의 창이 번개처럼 빛나는 것을 보았기 때문입니다.

decisions.choice: sun and moon stood still: the battle of Gibeon
decisions.reason: When Joshua fought at Gibeon, "the sun stood still, and the moon stopped" until Israel had won (Joshua 10:12-13). Habakkuk recalls it among the LORD's acts for his people. "Dwelling" is their lofty home in the sky.

decisions.choice: your arrows ... your spear: lightning
decisions.reason: God's arrows and spear are the lightning of the storm (Psalm 18:15; 77:18-19). Their light outshines the sun and moon.

decisions.choice: in the sky (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "in the sky" for "in their dwelling" (m1).

records.literal_gloss: In indignation you march through [the] earth; in anger you thresh nations.

en.L: In indignation {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} marched through [the] earth; \q in anger {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} threshed [the] nations.
en.B: In fury {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} strode across the earth; \q in anger {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} trampled the nations.
en.R: You were angry as {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} marched across the earth. \q In {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} anger {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} crushed the nations like grain.

es.L: Con indignación marchaste por [la] tierra; \q con ira trillaste [a las] naciones.
es.B: Con furor recorriste la tierra; \q con ira pisoteaste a las naciones.
es.R: Estabas enojado cuando marchaste por la tierra. \q En {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} enojo aplastaste a las naciones como se trilla el grano.

fr.L: Dans l’indignation {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as parcouru [la] terre ; \q dans la colère {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as battu [les] nations.
fr.B: Avec fureur {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as arpenté la terre ; \q avec colère {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as piétiné les nations.
fr.R: Tu étais en colère quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as traversé la terre. \q Dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} colère, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as écrasé les nations comme on bat le grain.

sw.L: Kwa ghadhabu ulipita katika dunia; \q kwa hasira uliyapura mataifa.
sw.B: Kwa ghadhabu ulitembea katika dunia; \q kwa hasira uliyakanyaga mataifa.
sw.R: Ulikuwa umekasirika ulipotembea katika dunia. \q Katika hasira {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} uliyaponda mataifa kama nafaka.

vi.L: Trong cơn phẫn nộ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đi khắp [mặt] đất; \q trong cơn giận {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đạp [các] dân tộc như đạp lúa.
vi.B: Trong cơn thịnh nộ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sải bước khắp đất; \q trong cơn giận {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giày đạp các dân tộc.
vi.R: Ngài nổi giận khi đi ngang qua khắp đất. \q Trong cơn giận, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nghiền nát các dân tộc như nghiền lúa.

ko.L: 주님께서 분노 가운데 땅을 두루 다니시고, \q 진노 가운데 민족들을 타작하셨습니다.
ko.B: 주님께서 격노하시며 땅을 활보하시고, \q 진노하시며 민족들을 짓밟으셨습니다.
ko.R: 주님께서 노하셔서 온 땅을 밟고 지나가셨습니다. \q 진노하셔서 곡식을 떨듯 민족들을 짓밟으셨습니다.

decisions.choice: you threshed the nations
decisions.reason: Threshing was done by animals treading the grain or by a heavy sledge dragged over it. It is a picture of crushing defeat (Micah 4:13; Isaiah 41:15; Amos 1:3).

decisions.choice: trampled (B); crushed ... like grain (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced says "trampled"; Readable keeps the threshing picture by saying "like grain".

source.text: יָצָ֨אתָ֙ לְיֵ֣שַׁע עַמֶּ֔ךָ לְיֵ֖שַׁע אֶת־מְשִׁיחֶ֑ךָ מָחַ֤צְתָּ רֹּאשׁ֙ מִבֵּ֣ית רָשָׁ֔ע עָר֛וֹת יְס֥וֹד עַד־צַוָּ֖אר סֶֽלָה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: You went out for [the] salvation of your people, for [the] salvation of your anointed; you crushed [the] head from [the] house of [the] wicked, laying bare [the] foundation to [the] neck. Selah.

en.L: You went forth for [the] salvation of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people, \q for saving {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} anointed; \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} smashed [the] head from [the] house of [the] wicked, \q laying [it] bare from foundation to neck. Selah
en.B: You went out to save {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people, \q to save {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} anointed one. \q You crushed the head of the house of the wicked, \q stripping it bare from the foundation up to the neck. Selah
en.R: You came out to save {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people, \q to save {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} chosen king. \q You crushed the leader of the wicked nation \q and destroyed his house completely, from top to bottom. Selah

es.L: Saliste para [la] salvación de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo, \q para salvar a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ungido; \q aplastaste [la] cabeza de [la] casa del malvado, \q desnudándo[la] desde el cimiento hasta el cuello. Selah
es.B: Saliste para salvar a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo, \q para salvar a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ungido. \q Aplastaste la cabeza de la casa del malvado, \q dejándola al descubierto desde el cimiento hasta el cuello. Selah
es.R: Saliste para salvar a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo, \q para salvar al rey que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} escogiste. \q Aplastaste al jefe de la nación malvada \q y destruiste su casa por completo, de arriba abajo. Selah

fr.L: Tu es sorti pour [le] salut de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple, \q pour sauver {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} oint ; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fracassé [la] tête de [la] maison du méchant, \q la mettant à nu des fondations jusqu’au cou. Sélah
fr.B: Tu es sorti pour sauver {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple, \q pour sauver celui que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as oint. \q Tu as écrasé la tête de la maison du méchant, \q la dénudant des fondations jusqu’au cou. Sélah
fr.R: Tu es venu sauver {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple, \q sauver le roi que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as choisi. \q Tu as écrasé le chef de la nation méchante \q et détruit entièrement sa maison, de fond en comble. Sélah

sw.L: Ulitoka kwa ajili ya wokovu wa watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, \q kwa ajili ya kumwokoa mpakwa mafuta {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}; \q uliponda kichwa cha nyumba ya mwovu, \q ukiiacha wazi tangu msingi hadi shingoni. Sela
sw.B: Ulitoka kuwaokoa watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, \q kumwokoa mpakwa mafuta {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}. \q Ulikiponda kichwa cha nyumba ya mwovu, \q ukiibomoa tangu msingi hadi shingoni. Sela
sw.R: Ulitoka kuwaokoa watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, \q kumwokoa mfalme uliyemchagua. \q Ulimponda kiongozi wa taifa ovu \q na kuiharibu nyumba yake kabisa, kuanzia juu hadi chini. Sela

vi.L: Ngài đã ra đi vì sự cứu rỗi dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q để cứu người được xức dầu của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đập tan đầu [của] nhà kẻ ác, \q phơi trần [nó] từ nền móng đến cổ. Sê-la
vi.B: Ngài đã ra đi để cứu dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q để cứu người {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã xức dầu. \q Ngài đập tan đầu của nhà kẻ ác, \q lột trần nó từ nền móng đến tận cổ. Sê-la
vi.R: Ngài đã đến để giải cứu dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q để giải cứu vị vua {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã chọn. \q Ngài đã đập tan kẻ lãnh đạo dân tộc gian ác \q và phá hủy hoàn toàn nhà của hắn, từ trên xuống dưới. Sê-la

ko.L: 주님께서 주님의 백성의 구원을 위하여, \q 주님의 기름 부음 받은 이를 구원하시려고 나가셨습니다. \q 주님께서 악인의 집의 머리를 부수시고, \q 기초부터 목까지 [그것을] 드러내셨습니다. 셀라
ko.B: 주님께서 주님의 백성을 구원하시려고, \q 주님께서 기름 부으신 이를 구원하시려고 나오셨습니다. \q 악인의 집의 우두머리를 부수시고, \q 그 집을 기초에서 목까지 벗겨 내셨습니다. 셀라
ko.R: 주님께서 주님의 백성을 구하시려고, \q 주님께서 택하신 왕을 구하시려고 나오셨습니다. \q 주님께서 악한 나라의 우두머리를 부수시고 \q 그 집을 위에서 아래까지 완전히 무너뜨리셨습니다. 셀라

decisions.choice: your anointed: the king
decisions.reason: The anointed one is the king of God's people, anointed with oil when he was made king (1 Samuel 16:13; Psalm 2:2; 18:51). In this line it stands in parallel with "your people", so the king may stand for the people as a whole (Psalm 28:8). The poem does not name a particular king.

decisions.choice: crushed the head of the house of the wicked, laying it bare from foundation to neck: total defeat
decisions.reason: Two pictures are joined: a house demolished down to its foundations, and an enemy struck on the head and stripped. The "head" is the leader of the wicked nation; the line says that he and his house are destroyed completely. The details of the line are uncertain.

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in this chapter (verses 3, 9 and 13). It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude. It is not part of what is said.

decisions.choice: anointed (L, B); chosen king (R)
decisions.reason: As in Isaiah 45:1, Readable says "chosen" for "anointed", and adds "king" (m1). The anointed one takes no deity_pronoun span. Selah stays at the end of the verse, as the Hebrew has it.

decisions.choice: the leader of the wicked nation ... from top to bottom
decisions.reason: Readable says what the two pictures mean (m2).

decisions.choice: "tu ungido" (L, B), "el rey que tú escogiste" (R); the anointed takes no span
decisions.reason: As the English and Isaiah 45:1 R (m1).

decisions.choice: "ton oint" (L), "celui que tu as oint" (B), "le roi que tu as choisi" (R); the anointed one takes no deity_pronoun span, only God's "ton" / "tu" do
decisions.reason: As Isaiah 45:1 R and the English (m1).

decisions.choice: "mpakwa mafuta wako" (L, B), "mfalme uliyemchagua" (R); the anointed takes no span
decisions.reason: As the Psalms' word for the anointed king and the English Readable (m1).

decisions.choice: "người được xức dầu của Ngài" (L), "người Ngài đã xức dầu" (B), "vị vua Ngài đã chọn" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Psalms and the English Readable (m1); the anointed takes no span.

decisions.choice: "주님의 기름 부음 받은 이" (L), "주님께서 기름 부으신 이" (B), "주님께서 택하신 왕" (R), without -시- for the king
decisions.reason: As the Psalms and the English Readable (m1).

source.text: נָקַ֤בְתָּ בְמַטָּיו֙ רֹ֣אשׁ פְּרָזָ֔יו יִסְעֲר֖וּ לַהֲפִיצֵ֑נִי עֲלִ֣יצֻתָ֔ם כְּמוֹ־לֶאֱכֹ֥ל עָנִ֖י בַּמִּסְתָּֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: You pierced with his shafts [the] head of his warriors; they storm to scatter me; their exultation [was] as to devour [the] afflicted in secret.

en.L: You pierced with his own shafts the head of his warriors \q [when] they stormed out to scatter me, \q their exulting [was] as [if] to devour \q the afflicted in [a] hiding place.
en.B: With his own arrows {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} pierced the head of his warriors \q when they stormed out to scatter me, \q gloating as if about to devour \q the helpless in their hiding place.
en.R: You used the enemy's own weapons to kill the leader of his soldiers \q when they rushed out like a storm to scatter me. \q They were happy, like someone about to attack \q a poor person who is hiding.

es.L: Traspasaste con sus propias saetas la cabeza de sus guerreros \q [cuando] se lanzaron como tempestad para dispersarme; \q su regocijo [era] como [para] devorar \q al afligido en [un] escondite.
es.B: Con sus propias flechas traspasaste la cabeza de sus guerreros \q cuando se lanzaron para dispersarme, \q regodeándose como quien está a punto de devorar \q al indefenso en su escondite.
es.R: Usaste las propias armas del enemigo para matar al jefe de sus soldados \q cuando se lanzaron como una tormenta para dispersarme. \q Estaban felices, como quien está a punto de atacar \q a un pobre que se esconde.

fr.L: Tu as percé de ses propres traits la tête de ses guerriers \q [quand] ils se sont rués pour me disperser, \q leur exultation [était] comme [pour] dévorer \q le malheureux dans [une] cachette.
fr.B: De ses propres flèches {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as percé la tête de ses guerriers \q quand ils se sont rués pour me disperser, \q jubilant comme s’ils allaient dévorer \q le pauvre dans sa cachette.
fr.R: Tu as tué le chef de ses soldats avec les propres armes de l’ennemi, \q quand ils ont foncé comme une tempête pour me disperser. \q Ils étaient joyeux, comme quelqu’un qui va attaquer \q un pauvre qui se cache.

sw.L: Ulichoma kwa mishale yake mwenyewe kichwa cha mashujaa wake \q wakati walipovamia kama dhoruba kunitawanya; \q shangwe yao [ilikuwa] kama ya kumla \q mnyonge mafichoni.
sw.B: Kwa mishale yake mwenyewe ulikichoma kichwa cha askari wake \q walipokuja kwa kasi kunitawanya, \q wakishangilia kana kwamba wanakaribia kumla \q mnyonge aliye mafichoni.
sw.R: Ulitumia silaha za adui mwenyewe kumuua kiongozi wa askari wake \q walipokuja kama dhoruba kunitawanya. \q Walifurahi, kama mtu anayekaribia kumshambulia \q maskini aliyejificha.

vi.L: Ngài đã dùng chính các mũi tên của nó đâm thủng đầu các chiến binh của nó \q [khi] chúng xông tới như bão để làm tan tác con; \q sự hớn hở của chúng [như thể] để nuốt \q kẻ khốn cùng trong [nơi] ẩn núp.
vi.B: Ngài dùng chính mũi tên của nó đâm thủng đầu các chiến binh của nó \q khi chúng ào tới để làm tan tác con, \q hả hê như sắp nuốt chửng \q người cô thế nơi ẩn núp.
vi.R: Ngài đã dùng chính vũ khí của kẻ thù để giết tên chỉ huy quân lính của nó \q khi chúng xông tới như bão tố để làm tan tác con. \q Chúng vui mừng như kẻ sắp tấn công \q một người nghèo đang trốn tránh.

ko.L: 주님께서 그의 화살들로 그의 용사들의 머리를 꿰뚫으셨습니다. \q 그들이 저를 흩으려고 폭풍처럼 몰려왔고, \q 그들의 기뻐함은 숨어 있는 \q 가련한 사람을 삼키려는 것과 같았습니다.
ko.B: 주님께서 그의 화살로 그 용사들의 우두머리를 꿰뚫으셨습니다. \q 그들이 저를 흩으려고 몰려왔을 때, \q 숨어 있는 힘없는 사람을 집어삼키려는 듯 \q 의기양양하던 자들이었습니다.
ko.R: 주님께서는 원수의 무기로 그 군대의 우두머리를 죽이셨습니다. \q 그들이 저를 흩으려고 폭풍처럼 몰려왔을 때였습니다. \q 그들은 숨어 있는 가난한 사람을 \q 덮치려는 사람처럼 기뻐했습니다.

decisions.choice: with his own shafts the head of his warriors: an obscure line
alternatives: with your arrows you pierced the head of his leaders
decisions.reason: The word for "shafts" is the one translated "arrows" in verse 9; it can also mean staffs. The word for "warriors" is rare and uncertain: it may mean warriors, leaders or villagers. The line seems to say that God turned the enemy's own weapons against him, as when enemies destroyed one another (Judges 7:22; 1 Samuel 14:20). The written text and the reading in the margin differ slightly in one word without changing the sense.

decisions.choice: to scatter me: the prophet speaks for his people
decisions.reason: Habakkuk says "me", speaking as one of the people whom the enemy came to scatter.

decisions.choice: as if to devour the afflicted in a hiding place
decisions.reason: The enemy is pictured as a robber or a lion lying in wait to seize the helpless (Psalm 10:8-9; 17:12).

decisions.choice: the enemy's own weapons; the leader of his soldiers
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what the line seems to mean (m1).

decisions.choice: "con" for the prophet's "me" while he speaks to God (8-15)
decisions.reason: He speaks for his people (m2) in a prayer addressed to God, so he says "con"; "tôi" returns in verse 16, where he speaks of himself.

source.text: דָּרַ֥כְתָּ בַיָּ֖ם סוּסֶ֑יךָ חֹ֖מֶר מַ֥יִם רַבִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: You trod on the sea [with] your horses, [the] heap of waters many.

en.L: You trod on the sea with {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} horses, \q the heaping of many waters.
en.B: You trampled the sea with {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} horses, \q churning the mighty waters.
en.R: You rode {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} horses across the sea, \q stirring up the great waters.

es.L: Pisaste el mar con {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} caballos, \q el amontonamiento de muchas aguas.
es.B: Pisoteaste el mar con {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} caballos, \q agitando las aguas poderosas.
es.R: Cabalgaste con {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} caballos por el mar, \q agitando las grandes aguas.

fr.L: Tu as foulé la mer avec {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} chevaux, \q le bouillonnement des grandes eaux.
fr.B: Tu as piétiné la mer avec {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} chevaux, \q en faisant bouillonner les eaux puissantes.
fr.R: Tu as traversé la mer sur {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} chevaux, \q en soulevant les grandes eaux.

sw.L: Uliikanyaga bahari kwa farasi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, \q chungu ya maji mengi.
sw.B: Uliikanyaga bahari kwa farasi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, \q ukiyavuruga maji makuu.
sw.R: Ulipanda farasi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} kuvuka bahari, \q ukiyatibua maji makuu.

vi.L: Ngài đã giẫm trên biển với các ngựa của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q giữa đống nước lớn.
vi.B: Ngài đã giày đạp biển cả bằng ngựa của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q khuấy động muôn dòng nước mạnh.
vi.R: Ngài cưỡi ngựa của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} băng qua biển, \q làm cho nước lớn cuộn sóng.

ko.L: 주님께서 주님의 말들로 바다를, \q 많은 물의 더미를 밟으셨습니다.
ko.B: 주님께서 주님의 말들로 바다를 짓밟으시니, \q 거센 물이 소용돌이쳤습니다.
ko.R: 주님께서 말을 타시고 바다를 건너시니, \q 큰 물결이 일어났습니다.

decisions.choice: you trod on the sea: the crossing of the Red Sea
decisions.reason: The poem returns to the sea of verse 8. At the exodus "the waters were heaped up" (Exodus 15:8), and "your way was through the sea, your path through the great waters" (Psalm 77:20). The word for "heaping" may also mean the foaming or surging of the water.

decisions.choice: churning (B); stirring up (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable describe the heaped, surging water as churned or stirred up by the horses.

source.text: שָׁמַ֣עְתִּי׀וַתִּרְגַּ֣ז בִּטְנִ֗י לְקוֹל֙ צָלֲל֣וּ שְׂפָתַ֔י יָב֥וֹא רָקָ֛ב בַּעֲצָמַ֖י וְתַחְתַּ֣י אֶרְגָּ֑ז אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָנ֨וּחַ֙ לְי֣וֹם צָרָ֔ה לַעֲל֖וֹת לְעַ֥ם יְגוּדֶֽנּוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: I heard, and my belly trembled; at [the] sound my lips quivered; rottenness entered into my bones, and under me I trembled, [so] that I will wait quietly for [the] day of distress, to come up on [the] people [who] invade us.

en.L: I heard, and my belly trembled; at the sound my lips quivered; \q rottenness entered my bones, and where I stood I trembled; \q yet I will wait quietly for [the] day of distress \q to come up on [the] people [who] invade us.
en.B: I heard, and my body trembled; my lips quivered at the sound. \q Decay entered my bones, and my legs shook beneath me. \q Yet I will wait quietly for the day of trouble \q to come on the people who invade us.
en.R: When I heard this, my whole body shook. My lips trembled with fear. \q My bones felt weak, and my legs shook under me. \q But I will wait calmly for the day of disaster \q that will come on the nation that attacks us.

es.L: Oí, y se estremeció mi vientre; al sonido temblaron mis labios; \q la podredumbre entró en mis huesos, y donde estaba temblé; \q con todo, esperaré tranquilo [el] día de la angustia \q [que] subirá contra [el] pueblo [que] nos invade.
es.B: Oí, y mi cuerpo se estremeció; mis labios temblaron al oír el sonido. \q La debilidad entró en mis huesos, y mis piernas flaquearon. \q Aun así, esperaré con calma el día de la angustia \q que vendrá sobre el pueblo que nos invade.
es.R: Cuando oí esto, todo mi cuerpo temblaba. Mis labios temblaban de miedo. \q Sentía débiles los huesos, y las piernas me temblaban. \q Pero esperaré tranquilo el día del desastre \q que vendrá sobre la nación que nos ataca.

fr.L: J’ai entendu, et mes entrailles ont tremblé ; au bruit, mes lèvres ont frémi ; \q la pourriture est entrée dans mes os, et là où j’étais, j’ai tremblé ; \q pourtant j’attendrai en silence [le] jour de la détresse \q [qui] montera contre [le] peuple [qui] nous attaque.
fr.B: J’ai entendu, et tout mon corps a tremblé ; mes lèvres ont frémi à ce bruit. \q La faiblesse a pénétré mes os, et mes jambes ont flanché sous moi. \q Pourtant j’attendrai avec calme le jour de la détresse \q qui viendra sur le peuple qui nous envahit.
fr.R: Quand j’ai entendu cela, tout mon corps a tremblé. Mes lèvres tremblaient de peur. \q Mes os n’avaient plus de force, et mes jambes tremblaient sous moi. \q Mais j’attendrai calmement le jour du désastre \q qui va tomber sur la nation qui nous attaque.

sw.L: Nilisikia, na tumbo langu likatetemeka; kwa sauti hiyo midomo yangu ikatikisika; \q uozo ukaingia mifupani mwangu, na pale nilipokuwa nikatetemeka; \q hata hivyo nitangoja kwa utulivu siku ya dhiki \q ije juu ya watu wanaotuvamia.
sw.B: Nilisikia, na mwili wangu wote ukatetemeka; midomo yangu ikatikisika kwa sauti hiyo. \q Udhaifu uliingia mifupani mwangu, na miguu yangu ikatetemeka chini yangu. \q Hata hivyo nitangoja kwa utulivu siku ya taabu \q ije juu ya watu wanaotuvamia.
sw.R: Niliposikia hayo, mwili wangu wote ulitetemeka. Midomo yangu ilitetemeka kwa hofu. \q Mifupa yangu iliishiwa nguvu, na miguu yangu ilitetemeka. \q Lakini nitangoja kwa utulivu siku ya maafa \q itakayolijia taifa linalotushambulia.

vi.L: Tôi đã nghe, và ruột gan tôi run rẩy; trước tiếng ấy môi tôi run lên; \q sự mục nát vào trong xương tôi, và tại chỗ tôi đứng, tôi run sợ; \q dầu vậy tôi sẽ yên lặng chờ đợi ngày hoạn nạn \q đến trên dân [đang] xâm chiếm chúng tôi.
vi.B: Tôi đã nghe, và toàn thân tôi run rẩy; môi tôi run lên khi nghe tiếng ấy. \q Xương cốt tôi rã rời, và chân tôi run lẩy bẩy. \q Dù vậy, tôi sẽ bình tâm chờ đợi ngày hoạn nạn \q giáng xuống dân xâm lăng chúng tôi.
vi.R: Khi nghe điều đó, toàn thân tôi run rẩy. Môi tôi run lên vì sợ. \q Xương cốt tôi rã rời, chân tôi run lẩy bẩy. \q Nhưng tôi sẽ bình tĩnh chờ đợi ngày tai họa \q sẽ giáng trên dân tộc đang tấn công chúng tôi.

ko.L: 내가 들었고 내 배가 떨렸으며, 그 소리에 내 입술이 떨렸다. \q 썩음이 내 뼈에 들어오고, 내가 선 자리에서 떨었다. \q 그러나 나는 환난의 날을 조용히 기다릴 것이니, \q 그날이 우리를 침략하는 백성에게 닥칠 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 듣고 온몸이 떨렸고, 그 소리에 내 입술이 떨렸다. \q 뼈가 썩어 들어가는 듯하고, 다리가 후들거렸다. \q 그러나 나는 우리를 침략하는 백성에게 \q 환난의 날이 닥치기를 잠잠히 기다리겠다.
ko.R: 그 소리를 듣고 내 온몸이 떨렸다. 두려움에 입술까지 떨렸다. \q 뼈에서 힘이 빠지고, 다리가 후들후들 떨렸다. \q 그러나 나는 우리를 공격하는 나라에 \q 재앙의 날이 닥치기를 조용히 기다리겠다.

decisions.choice: belly, lips, bones: terror felt through the whole body
decisions.reason: Habakkuk describes overwhelming fear in bodily terms, as Jeremiah 23:9 and Daniel 10:8 do. The "belly" is the inner body; "rottenness in the bones" means that strength has drained away (Proverbs 12:4; 14:30).

decisions.choice: yet I will wait quietly for the day of distress
alternatives: I tremble because I must wait for the day of distress
decisions.reason: The word that joins the lines can mean "yet", "so that" or "because". It is taken here to mean that, though he trembles, he will wait calmly for the day when distress comes on the invader, as the vision promised (2:3). It may also mean that he trembles because he must wait through the day of distress coming on his own people.

decisions.choice: my body (B, R); my legs shook beneath me (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "body" for "belly" and turn "under me I trembled" into the plain sense: his legs gave way.

decisions.choice: "tôi" and "chúng tôi" from verse 16 on
decisions.reason: The prophet speaks of himself and his people, no longer to God.

decisions.choice: Verses 16-19 return to the plain style with "나", speaking about God with -시-
decisions.reason: The prophet now speaks of himself and of God, no longer to God, as the Psalms turn.

source.text: כִּֽי־תְאֵנָ֣ה לֹֽא־תִפְרָ֗ח וְאֵ֤ין יְבוּל֙ בַּגְּפָנִ֔ים כִּחֵשׁ֙ מַעֲשֵׂה־זַ֔יִת וּשְׁדֵמ֖וֹת לֹא־עָ֣שָׂה אֹ֑כֶל גָּזַ֤ר מִמִּכְלָה֙ צֹ֔אן וְאֵ֥ין בָּקָ֖ר בָּרְפָתִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: For [the] fig tree not does blossom, and there is no produce on the vines; fails [the] yield of [the] olive, and fields not do produce food; is cut off from [the] fold [the] flock, and there are no cattle in the stalls,

en.L: Though [the] fig tree does not blossom and there is no fruit on the vines, \q [though the] yield of [the] olive fails \q and [the] fields do not make food, \q [though the] flock is cut off from [the] fold \q and there are no cattle in the stalls,
en.B: Though the fig tree does not flower and the vines bear no grapes, \q though the olive harvest fails \q and the fields yield nothing to eat, \q though the sheep vanish from the pen \q and the stalls hold no cattle,
en.R: The fig trees may not bloom, and there may be no grapes on the vines. \q The olive trees may give no olives, \q and the fields may produce no food. \q There may be no sheep in the pens \q and no cattle in the barns.

es.L: Aunque [la] higuera no eche flor y las parras no tengan fruto, \q [aunque] se pierda lo que da el olivo \q y [los] sembrados no produzcan comida, \q [aunque el] rebaño sea arrancado del corral \q y en los pesebres no haya reses,
es.B: Aunque la higuera no se cubra de flores y las parras no den uvas, \q aunque se malogre la cosecha de aceitunas \q y los campos no den nada que comer, \q aunque las ovejas desaparezcan del corral \q y los establos se queden sin ganado,
es.R: Puede que las higueras no florezcan y que no haya uvas en las parras. \q Puede que los olivos no den aceitunas \q y que los campos no produzcan comida. \q Puede que no haya ovejas en los corrales \q ni vacas en los establos.

fr.L: Bien que [le] figuier ne fleurisse pas et qu’il n’y ait pas de fruit aux vignes, \q [que le] rapport de [l’]olivier fasse défaut \q et que [les] champs ne donnent pas de nourriture, \q [que le] petit bétail soit retranché de [l’]enclos \q et qu’il n’y ait pas de gros bétail dans les étables,
fr.B: Même si le figuier ne bourgeonne pas et si les vignes restent sans raisins, \q même si la récolte des olives est perdue \q et si les champs ne rapportent rien à manger, \q même si les moutons disparaissent de l’enclos \q et si les étables restent sans bétail,
fr.R: Il se peut que les figuiers ne fleurissent pas et qu’il n’y ait pas de raisins sur les vignes. \q Il se peut que les oliviers ne donnent pas d’olives \q et que les champs ne produisent pas de nourriture. \q Il se peut qu’il n’y ait plus de moutons dans les enclos \q ni de vaches dans les étables.

sw.L: Ingawa mtini hauchanui maua, wala hakuna zao katika mizabibu, \q [ingawa] mazao ya mzeituni yanapungua, \q na mashamba hayatoi chakula, \q [ingawa] kundi limekatiliwa mbali na zizi, \q wala hakuna ng'ombe katika mabanda,
sw.B: Hata kama mtini hautoi maua na mizabibu haizai zabibu, \q hata kama mavuno ya mizeituni yanashindwa \q na mashamba hayatoi chochote cha kula, \q hata kama kondoo wanatoweka zizini \q na mabanda hayana ng'ombe,
sw.R: Huenda mitini isichanue maua, na mizabibu isiwe na zabibu. \q Huenda mizeituni isitoe zeituni, \q na mashamba yasitoe chakula. \q Huenda kusiwe na kondoo mazizini, \q wala ng'ombe katika mabanda.

vi.L: Cây vả không trổ hoa và cây nho chẳng có trái; \q hoa lợi cây ô-liu thất bại \q và ruộng đồng chẳng sinh ra lương thực; \q bầy chiên bị cất khỏi chuồng \q và chẳng còn bò trong chuồng trại.
vi.B: Cây vả không ra hoa, cây nho không có trái; \q vụ ô-liu thất thu, \q đồng ruộng chẳng cho gì để ăn; \q chuồng chiên trống trơn, \q trại bò không còn con nào.
vi.R: Có thể cây vả không nở hoa, và cây nho không có trái. \q Có thể cây ô-liu không ra quả, \q và đồng ruộng không sinh ra thức ăn. \q Có thể chuồng không còn chiên, \q và trại không còn bò.

ko.L: 무화과나무가 꽃을 피우지 않고 포도덩굴에 소출이 없으며, \q 올리브 나무의 수확이 끊기고 \q 밭이 양식을 내지 못하며, \q 양 떼가 우리에서 끊어지고 \q 축사에 소 떼가 없다.
ko.B: 무화과나무에 꽃이 피지 않고 포도덩굴에 포도송이가 없다. \q 올리브 수확은 실패하고 \q 들판은 먹을 것을 하나도 내지 못한다. \q 양들은 우리에서 사라지고 \q 축사에는 소 한 마리 없다.
ko.R: 무화과나무가 꽃을 피우지 못하고, 포도덩굴에 포도가 열리지 않을 수도 있다. \q 올리브 나무에 열매가 맺히지 않고, \q 밭에서 먹을 것이 나지 않을 수도 있다. \q 우리에 양이 한 마리도 없고, \q 축사에 소 한 마리 남지 않을 수도 있다.

decisions.choice: though: even if everything fails
decisions.reason: The verse lists everything a farming people lived on: figs, grapes, olives, grain, sheep and cattle (Deuteronomy 8:8; Joel 1:10-12). The word at the start may mean "though" or "for": either the prophet imagines the worst, or he describes the ruin the invasion will bring. Either way, verse 18 says that his joy does not depend on them.

decisions.choice: the flock is cut off from the fold
decisions.reason: The sheep and goats are gone from their pen, taken by the enemy or dead from want of pasture.

decisions.choice: Though (L, B); may (R); the comma at the end (L, B)
decisions.reason: The sentence runs on into verse 18, so Literal and Balanced end with a comma. Readable makes each line a sentence with "may" and begins verse 18 with "Even then".

decisions.choice: "Aunque …" (L, B), ending with a comma; "Puede que …" (R) in full sentences
decisions.reason: The sentence runs on into verse 18, as the English; the lines are drafted from the gloss and kept away from the familiar wording.

decisions.choice: "Bien que …" (L), "Même si …" (B), ending with a comma; "Il se peut que …" (R) in full sentences
decisions.reason: The sentence runs on into verse 18, as the English; Readable uses "may" and begins verse 18 with "Même alors". The verse is drafted fresh from the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: "Ingawa …" (L), "Hata kama …" (B), ending with a comma; "Huenda …" (R)
decisions.reason: The sentence runs on into verse 18, as the English; drafted from the gloss, away from the Union Version's wording.

decisions.choice: Verse 17 closes as its own sentence at every level: the losses are stated (L, B) or put with "Có thể" (R), and "though" is carried by "Dẫu thế" / "Dù vậy" / "Ngay cả khi ấy" at the start of verse 18
decisions.reason: Vietnamese closes each verse where a Hebrew sentence runs across verses (Psalms rule); the opening word can also mean "for" (m1), so stating the losses keeps the sense.

decisions.choice: Verse 17 closes as its own sentence ("… 없다" L, B; "… 수도 있다" R), and "그럴지라도" / "그때에도" at the start of verse 18 carries the "though"
decisions.reason: Korean closes each verse where a Hebrew sentence runs across verses (Psalms rule); the lines are drafted away from the familiar 개역 and 새번역 wording.

source.text: וַאֲנִ֖י בַּיהוָ֣ה אֶעְל֑וֹזָה אָגִ֖ילָה בֵּאלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: yet I, in Yahweh I will exult; I will rejoice in [the] God of my salvation.

en.L: yet I, in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} I will exult; \q I will rejoice in [the] God of my salvation.
en.B: yet I will rejoice in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; \q I will find joy in God, my Savior.
en.R: Even then I will be glad because of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q I will be joyful because God saves me.

es.L: yo, sin embargo, en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} exultaré; \q saltaré de júbilo en [el] Dios de mi salvación.
es.B: yo de todos modos me alegraré en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; \q encontraré mi gozo en Dios, mi Salvador.
es.R: Aun entonces me alegraré por {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. \q Estaré feliz porque Dios me salva.

fr.L: moi, pourtant, dans {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} je bondirai de joie ; \q j’exulterai dans [le] Dieu de mon salut.
fr.B: moi, je me réjouirai quand même dans {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; \q je trouverai ma joie en Dieu, mon Sauveur.
fr.R: Même alors, je serai heureux grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. \q Je serai plein de joie, car Dieu me sauve.

sw.L: lakini mimi, katika {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} nitashangilia; \q nitafurahi katika Mungu wa wokovu wangu.
sw.B: hata hivyo nitafurahi katika {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; \q nitapata furaha katika Mungu, Mwokozi wangu.
sw.R: Hata hapo nitafurahi kwa sababu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Nitashangilia kwa sababu Mungu ananiokoa.

vi.L: Dẫu thế, tôi, tôi sẽ hân hoan trong {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; \q tôi sẽ mừng rỡ nơi Đức Chúa Trời của sự cứu rỗi tôi.
vi.B: Dù vậy, tôi vẫn vui mừng trong {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; \q tôi vẫn reo vui nơi Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng Cứu Rỗi tôi.
vi.R: Ngay cả khi ấy, tôi vẫn vui mừng vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. \q Tôi vẫn hớn hở vì Đức Chúa Trời giải cứu tôi.

ko.L: 그럴지라도 나, 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}로 인해 환호하고, \q 내 구원의 하나님으로 인해 기뻐 뛰겠다.
ko.B: 그럴지라도 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}로 인해 기뻐하고, \q 나의 구원자 하나님 안에서 즐거움을 찾겠다.
ko.R: 그때에도 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 때문에 기뻐하겠다. \q 하나님께서 나를 구원하시니 즐거워하겠다.

decisions.choice: yet I will exult in the LORD: joy in God himself
decisions.reason: The prophet who began with complaint ends with joy. His joy rests not on the harvest or on his circumstances but on the LORD himself, the God who saves him (Psalm 73:25-26). "I" is emphatic in the Hebrew: whatever happens, I will rejoice.

decisions.choice: the God of my salvation: God who rescues me
decisions.reason: The word is the one used in verses 8 and 13 for the LORD's rescue of his people. The phrase is common in the Psalms (Psalm 18:47; 25:5).

decisions.choice: God, my Savior (B); because God saves me (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "Savior" and "saves" for "salvation", the noun's sense here (m2).

decisions.choice: "yo, sin embargo, en el SEÑOR exultaré" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the emphatic "I" and the Hebrew order (m1), worded away from the familiar versions.

decisions.choice: "moi, pourtant, dans le SEIGNEUR je bondirai de joie" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the emphatic "I" and the Hebrew order (m1); the line is drafted fresh from the gloss.

decisions.choice: "lakini mimi, katika BWANA nitashangilia" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the emphatic "I" and the Hebrew order (m1).

decisions.choice: "tôi, tôi sẽ hân hoan" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal repeats the pronoun to keep the Hebrew's emphatic "I" (m1).

decisions.choice: "나, 나는" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal repeats the pronoun to keep the Hebrew's emphatic "I" (m1).

source.text: יְהוִ֤הּאֲדֹנָי֙ חֵילִ֔י וַיָּ֤שֶׂם רַגְלַי֙ כָּֽאַיָּל֔וֹת וְעַ֥ל בָּמוֹתַ֖י יַדְרִכֵ֑נִי לַמְנַצֵּ֖חַ בִּנְגִינוֹתָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Yahweh, [the] Lord, [is] my strength, and he makes my feet like the does, and on my high places he makes me tread. To the director, with my stringed instruments.

en.L: {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} my Lord [is] my strength, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} makes my feet like the does', \q and on my heights {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} makes me tread. \q For the director: with stringed instruments.
en.B: The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} is my strength; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} makes my feet as sure as a deer's \q and lets me walk on the heights. \q For the music director. With stringed instruments.
en.R: The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} is my strength. \q He makes me sure-footed like a deer. \q He lets me walk safely high up in the mountains. \q For the leader of the music. To be played on stringed instruments.

es.L: {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}, mi Señor, [es] mi fuerza; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hace mis pies como [los] de las ciervas, \q y sobre mis alturas {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me hace andar. \q Al director del coro: con instrumentos de cuerda.
es.B: El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} es mi fuerza; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hace mis pies tan seguros como los del ciervo \q y me hace andar por las alturas. \q Al director del coro. Con instrumentos de cuerda.
es.R: El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} es mi fuerza. \q Me hace caminar seguro como un ciervo. \q Me deja andar a salvo en lo alto de las montañas. \q Para el director de la música. Para tocarse con instrumentos de cuerda.

fr.L: {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}, mon Seigneur, [est] ma force ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} rend mes pieds comme [ceux] des biches, \q et sur mes hauteurs {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} me fait marcher. \q Au chef de chœur : avec instruments à cordes.
fr.B: Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} est ma force ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} rend mes pieds aussi sûrs que ceux d’une biche \q et me fait marcher sur les hauteurs. \q Au chef de chœur. Avec instruments à cordes.
fr.R: Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} est ma force. \q Il me donne le pied sûr comme une biche. \q Il me fait marcher en sécurité tout en haut des montagnes. \q Pour le chef des musiciens. À jouer sur des instruments à cordes.

sw.L: {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} Bwana wangu [ni] nguvu yangu, \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} huifanya miguu yangu kama ya kulungu jike, \q na juu ya mahali pangu pa juu hunitembeza. \q Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya: kwa ala zangu za nyuzi.
sw.B: Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} ni nguvu yangu; \q {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} huifanya miguu yangu kuwa imara kama ya ayala \q na kunitembeza juu ya vilele. \q Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya. Kwa ala zangu za nyuzi.
sw.R: Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} ni nguvu yangu. \q Ananifanya niwe na miguu imara kama ya ayala. \q Ananiruhusu nitembee salama juu milimani. \q Kwa kiongozi wa waimbaji. Ipigwe kwa ala za nyuzi.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Chúa tôi, [là] sức mạnh của tôi; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm cho chân tôi như [chân] nai cái, \q và trên các nơi cao của tôi, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho tôi bước đi. \q Cho người chỉ huy [ban nhạc]: với đàn dây.
vi.B: Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} chính là sức mạnh của tôi; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm cho chân tôi vững như chân nai \q và cho tôi bước đi trên các nơi cao. \q Cho nhạc trưởng. Với đàn dây.
vi.R: Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} chính là sức mạnh của tôi. \q Ngài làm cho chân tôi vững vàng như chân nai. \q Ngài cho tôi bước đi an toàn trên núi cao. \q Cho người hướng dẫn ban nhạc. Để chơi bằng đàn dây.

ko.L: {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}} 나의 주님께서 나의 힘이시니, \q 그분께서 내 발을 암사슴들의 [발]처럼 만드시고, \q 나의 높은 곳을 내가 밟게 하신다. \q 지휘자를 위하여. 현악기에 맞추어.
ko.B: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 나의 힘이시다. \q 그분께서 내 발을 사슴의 발처럼 든든하게 하시고 \q 높은 곳을 걷게 하신다. \q 음악 지휘자를 위하여. 현악기에 맞추어.
ko.R: 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 나의 힘이시다. \q 그분께서 사슴처럼 내 발을 튼튼하게 하신다. \q 높은 산 위에서도 안전하게 걷게 하신다. \q 찬양 인도자를 위해 현악기로 연주하는 노래.

decisions.choice: GOD my Lord: the divine name and the title
decisions.reason: Here the name comes before the title (*'Adonai*), as in Psalm 140:8. The name is then read aloud as "God" so as not to say "Lord" twice.

decisions.choice: my feet like the does', on my heights: the words of Psalm 18:34
decisions.reason: David says the same of God in Psalm 18:34 (2 Samuel 22:34): "making my feet like the does', and on my heights he makes me stand". Habakkuk says "tread" or "walk". The doe is sure-footed on steep, rocky heights; God gives him safety and strength to stand where others would fall. Deuteronomy 32:13 and Isaiah 58:14 speak of riding on the heights of the land.

decisions.choice: For the director: with stringed instruments: a note for the leader of the temple music
decisions.reason: The psalm closes with the kind of note that stands at the head of many psalms (Psalm 4:1): it is for the leader of the music, to be played on stringed instruments. Here it comes at the end, and the Hebrew says "my stringed instruments". It shows that the prayer was used in worship.

decisions.choice: GOD my Lord (L); the Lord GOD (B, R); the Psalm 18:34 wording
decisions.reason: As in Psalm 140:8, the name is written GOD so that the two are not read as "Lord Lord"; Balanced and Readable use the familiar order. The lines about the feet and the heights take the published wording of Psalm 18:34 at each level, with "tread" or "walk" for Habakkuk's verb.

decisions.choice: the Psalm 4:1 wording for the note
decisions.reason: The note to the director follows Psalm 4:1 at each level: "For the director: with stringed instruments" (Literal), "For the music director. With stringed instruments" (Balanced), "For the leader of the music. To be played on stringed instruments" (Readable). It stands as the last line of the verse.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}}, mi Señor" (L), "el Señor DIOS" (B, R), as Psalm 140:8; Psalm 18:34's words with "andar" for Habakkuk's verb; the note as Psalm 4:1
decisions.reason: As m1-m3; "mis" of "my stringed instruments" is left out, as the settled note has it.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}}, mon Seigneur" (L), "le Seigneur DIEU" (B, R), as Psalm 140:8; the feet and heights as the published Psalm 18:34 with "marcher" for Habakkuk’s verb; the closing note as Psalm 4:1 at each level
decisions.reason: The name stands before the title (m1); the lines take the words of Psalm 18:34 (m2) and the note the words of Psalm 4:1 (m3).

decisions.choice: "MUNGU Bwana wangu" (L), "Bwana MUNGU" (B, R), as Psalm 140:8; Psalm 18:34's words with "hunitembeza"; the note "Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya: kwa ala zangu za nyuzi" (L, B), as Psalm 4:1 with Habakkuk's "my"
decisions.reason: As m1-m3 and the terms for Habakkuk 3.

decisions.choice: "CHÚA, Chúa tôi" (L), "Chúa là CHÚA" (B, R); Psalm 18:34's words with "bước đi"; the note as Psalm 4:1 at each level
decisions.reason: As m1-m3.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:하나님|야훼}} 나의 주님" (L), "주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서" (B, R), with 께서 after the span; Psalm 18:34's words with "밟게 / 걷게 하신다"; the note as Psalm 4:1 at each level
decisions.reason: As m1-m3; 께서 reads correctly after both 하나님 and 야훼.
